name: notify
title: Notify the people around an API
description: Tells the people APIM knows around an API what you decided to tell them, over the channel they have. Who they are comes from APIM's own memberships and subscriptions: `audience` consumer_owners is the primary owner of each application subscribed to the API, consumer_members every member of those applications, subscribers the users who subscribed; webhook posts to a URL instead (a Slack incoming webhook works). A call without `confirm` is a dry run: it returns who would be reached and the message as it would go, and sends nothing. Show that to the user, then call again with confirm=true. Every send is audited under the authenticated user.

environment.description: Id, HRID or name of an environment. Omit when `api` names an API that exists in only one environment you can read.

api.description: Id or name of the API.

channel.description: portal: a notification in the Console and the Portal. mail: an email. webhook: a POST to webhookUrl, with audience webhook.

text.description: What to tell them: what is wrong, since when, what they should do. Plain text.

webhookUrl.description: webhook channel only. Must be allowed by the server's webhook whitelist.

confirm.description: true to send. Omitted or false: dry run.

recipients.description: The people reached, or that would be; empty for a webhook.

sent.description: How many recipients it went to. Absent on a dry run.
